summary.title: Overview
summary.description: Unified health, traffic and error observability — Summary & Monitoring in one place.

beta.title: This module is in beta
beta.description: Today the API console is read-only — it lets you inspect, monitor and test your routes. In an upcoming release you'll be able to **edit routes directly**, adjust their parameters, **configure their documentation without coding**, and **compose what each route does with visual logic blocks** — wiring triggers, conditions and actions on a node canvas, no code required. Antelope is actively building this; it ships alongside the **Module Builder**, the upcoming way to configure the whole platform without writing code.

doc.path_params_description: Values extracted from the URL pattern (e.g. :id).
doc.query_params_description: Values read from the URL query string.
doc.body_description: Parsed JSON body fields. Inferred — full schema awaits a storage point.
doc.raw_body_description: Raw buffer body, available to the handler unparsed.
doc.context_description: Bare request context injected into the handler.
doc.result_description: Response object, available to postfix-style handlers.
doc.stream_description: Writable stream used for streaming responses.
doc.unknown_params_description: Parameters using a custom provider we couldn't classify. The raw provider source is available below.
doc.no_authentication: No auth middleware applies to this route.
doc.error_responses_description: Inferred from assert(...) and HTTPResult(...) calls in the handler source.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Own routes = your project's code only. Module routes = installed Antelope modules only. All routes = no filtering.

retention.log_retention_description: How long detailed request logs are kept before pruning. Leave empty to use the module configuration default.
retention.stats_retention_description: How long aggregated per-day statistics are kept. Leave empty to use the module configuration default.
retention.slowness_description: Latency above which a request is flagged as slow. Leave empty to use the module configuration default.
retention.max_body_description: Request/response bodies above this size are stored truncated. Leave empty to use the module configuration default.
